vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: a-stock-analysis
Version: 1.0.0

This skill is designed for A-share stock analysis and portfolio management. It fetches public stock data from Sina Finance APIs (hq.sinajs.cn, quotes.sina.cn) and stores user portfolio data locally in a designated skill-specific JSON file (~/.clawdbot/skills/a-stock-analysis/portfolio.json). There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, obfuscation, or prompt injection attempts in SKILL.md. All network and file system operations are aligned with the stated purpose and confined to expected boundaries.

llm.summary: This A-share stock tool is mostly purpose-aligned, but it stores and mutates local portfolio financial records with limited safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to Sina Finance endpoints are expected for realtime market data; local storage under the user's home directory is purpose-aligned but contains cost and quantity holdings data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No separate installer, package dependency list, remote payload loader, or tool-spoofing mechanism was found in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The documented commands are scoped to stock lookup and portfolio management, but add/update/remove/analyze can write persistent holdings data and remove deletes entries without an extra confirmation or undo path.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The portfolio is persisted as plaintext JSON at ~/.clawdbot/skills/a-stock-analysis/portfolio.json using default file creation behavior, and portfolio records can be updated or deleted without confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's market lookup, minute-volume analysis, and portfolio commands fit its stated A-share analysis and holdings-management purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you plan to record real holdings. It will store stock codes, costs, quantities, and timestamps locally in plaintext, and an agent can add, update, or remove those records when using the portfolio commands. Keep backups of important portfolio data and avoid storing sensitive holdings on shared machines unless you are comfortable with the local file exposure risk.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Confirmed that portfolio add/update/remove operations are part of the stated purpose, but removal immediately rewrites the local portfolio without confirmation, backup, or soft-delete.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only interface matches the China A-share market focus and is not treated as a security concern here.
[T09] expected: Confirmed local plaintext storage of portfolio holdings; this is expected for a simple local portfolio tracker, but the lack of explicit restrictive permissions or atomic replacement leaves a privacy and data-loss concern.
